review:
Grand Patron is a cartel-movie slot with two extra reels, one above and one below the main grid. Only one symbol per spin lands on each extra reel, but it affects the main reels: symbols can spawn, turn wild, explode, multiply or even get 'arrested'.

Two special-agent badge scatters can trigger the bonus, and there are three variations of free spins in which the extra reels open their cells one by one. BGaming lists a 10,000x maximum and a 96.67% RTP but doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game. Free spins arrive about once every 277 spins. It's one of the more inventive designs in BGaming's catalogue.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
